skills.name: create_table_google_docs
skills.intent: Formats and pastes a rich HTML/TSV table directly into Google Docs or a web document in Chrome.
skills.description: Formats and pastes a rich HTML/TSV table directly into Google Docs or a web document in Chrome.

skills.name: create_table_word
skills.intent: Creates and populates a native formatted table in Microsoft Word via COM automation.
skills.description: Creates and populates a native formatted table in Microsoft Word via COM automation.

skills.name: tile_windows
skills.intent: Tiles two open applications side-by-side (50% left, 50% right) on the screen.
skills.description: Tiles two open applications side-by-side (50% left, 50% right) on the screen.

parameters.left_app: Application name to position on the left (e.g. 'notepad')
parameters.right_app: Application name to position on the right (e.g. 'chrome')

skills.name: tile_all_active_windows
skills.intent: Detects all open, visible non-minimized application windows on the primary display and tiles them evenly side by side across the desktop work area.
skills.description: Detects all open, visible non-minimized application windows on the primary display and tiles them evenly side by side across the desktop work area.

skills.name: google_docs_writer
skills.intent: Safely focuses Google Docs canvas in Chrome, stages formatted content to Windows clipboard, performs focus handshake, dispatches paste, and verifies visual outcome.
skills.description: Safely focuses Google Docs canvas in Chrome, stages formatted content to Windows clipboard, performs focus handshake, dispatches paste, and verifies visual outcome.

parameters.text: The text or document content to write into Google Docs
